description.value: Vernon Hostel is a centrally located budget hostel in Vernon, BC, offering shared-bathroom rooms with linens and towels included. Guests have access to a shared kitchen, a lounge with TV and billiards, and on-site laundry. The property sits near Kalamalka Lake Provincial Park and is a convenient base for cycling routes to Silver Star Mountain Resort (19 km) and the broader Okanagan region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (http://vernon-hostel.bedcanada.com/) is a third-party aggregator page (bedcanada.com) rather than the hostel's own website, as evidenced by 'More great choices' listings for accommodation in Poland, Belgium, Slovenia, and Finland — unrelated to a Vernon BC hostel. The site confirms the property name, address (3315 30 Avenue, V1T 2C9 Vernon), free WiFi, and on-site laundry but provides no information about bike storage or bike-handling procedures. The contact page shows only the address with no phone number, so the OSM phone cannot be confirmed from the website.
